import re
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
din,dout=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
test=G['Test input']
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for r in grid for v in r), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # find marker: color appearing once
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    marker=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==1 and c!=bg]
    marker=marker[0]
    mi,mj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==marker][0]
    # bars: runs of non-bg colors other than marker
    bars=[]
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if grid[i][j] not in (bg,marker):
                c=grid[i][j]; k=j
                while k<w and grid[i][k]==c: k+=1
                if k-j>1: bars.append((i,j,k-1,c))
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    top=min(bars); bot=max(bars)
    off=mj-top[1]
    col=bot[1]+off
    out=[list(r) for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        if out[i][col]==bg: out[i][col]=marker
    out[mi][mj]=4
    return out
o=transform(din)

print(o)

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==1 and c!=bg][0]
    mi,mj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==marker][0]
    bars=[]
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            if grid[i][j] not in (bg,marker):
                c=grid[i][j]; k=j
                while k<w and grid[i][k]==c: k+=1
                if k-j>1: bars.append((i,j,k-1,c))
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    top=min(bars); bot=max(bars)
    col=bot[1]+(mj-top[1])
    out=[list(r) for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        if out[i][col]==bg: out[i][col]=marker
    for i in range(top[0]+1, mi):
        if out[i][mj]==bg: out[i][mj]=marker
    out[mi][mj]=4
    return out
